title: Rust: Composite Pattern
description: Implement the composite pattern for tree-like object structures.

steps.title: Component Trait
steps.description: Define a `FileSystemNode` trait with `fn name(&self) -> &str` and `fn size(&self) -> u64`. Implement `File { name, size }`. Create a file and print its name and size.
hints: `trait FileSystemNode { fn name(&self) -> &str; fn size(&self) -> u64; }`

verification.failureMessage: Create a file node and print its name and size.

steps.title: Composite (Directory)
steps.description: Create a `Directory` struct that contains children: `Vec<Box<dyn FileSystemNode>>`. Implement `name()` and `size()` (sum of children's sizes). Create a directory with files and print its size.
hints: `struct Directory { name: String, children: Vec<Box<dyn FileSystemNode>> }`

verification.failureMessage: Create a directory with files and print its total size.

steps.title: Nested Composites
steps.description: Create a nested structure: `root` > `docs` (README, manual.pdf), `src` (main.rs, lib.rs), file `Cargo.toml`. Print the total size of the project root.
hints: Create File nodes for each file.
Root directory contains docs, src, and Cargo.toml.

verification.failureMessage: Build a project directory tree and print the root size.

steps.title: Visitor Traversal
steps.description: Implement a visitor: `FileSystemVisitor` trait with `fn visit_file(&mut self, file: &File)` and `fn visit_dir(&mut self, dir: &Directory)`. Implement a `ListVisitor` that prints the full tree structure with indentation.
hints: `trait FileSystemVisitor { fn visit_file(&mut self, file: &File); fn visit_dir(&mut self, dir: &Directory, depth: usize); }`

verification.failureMessage: Traverse the project tree with ListVisitor and print the tree.

steps.title: Find by Name
steps.description: Add a `find(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&dyn FileSystemNode>` method. Search recursively through the tree. Test by finding a file named "manual.pdf".
hints: If file name matches, return Some(file).
For directories, search children first. If found in child, return it.

verification.failureMessage: Search the tree for 'manual.pdf' and print the result.
